name: startall
description: Start all VMs and containers located on this node (by default only those with onboot=1).

params.name: force
params.description: Issue start command even if virtual guest have 'onboot' not set or set to off.

params.name: max-workers
params.description: Defines the maximum number of tasks running concurrently. If not set, uses 'max_workers' from datacenter.cfg, and if that's not set, the available CPU threads, clamped to a maximum of 8, are used.

params.name: vms
params.description: Only consider guests from this comma separated list of VMIDs.

permissions.description: The 'VM.PowerMgmt' permission is required on '/' or on '/vms/<ID>' for each ID passed via the 'vms' parameter.
